free_tier.stated: a sandbox mode lets a key holder try the API before a contract with demo content, no main renditions and no billing.
free_tier.notes: Content item prices come from the plan of the contract and are returned on request; a plan meters downloads in meter ticks or credits. The sandbox mode serves demo content only and the same API key opens every mode the account may use; how a key is obtained before a contract is unverified: behind a sales contact.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated; search reaches 30 days of content and the feed up to the last 72 hours, depending on the contract

retention.stated: search covers 30 days of content plus the archive of pictures, video, audio and graphics the contract allows; the feed and the agent reach back 72 hours

egress.terms: not applicable to the API answers; a content item has a price or a count against the plan meter

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.ap.org/media (content feed, search, item, account plans and quotas) with an OpenAPI file and an API explorer; the key goes in the x-api-key header; an AP Media Agent downloads a continuous feed
tooling: any HTTP client; the AP Media Agent
chaining: Text, picture, graphic, video and audio items with AP metadata and curated links; the delivery is B2B into a content ingestion system or CMS.

limits.value: unverified: quotas limit the calls per minute and per day of an API key and their size is read with an account call that needs a key
an API key and the content rights come from a contract with AP sales or licensing

binding_note: Nothing is served without a key that a contract provides, so the contract gate binds before any rate.

identity_cost.detail: Access follows a contract with AP sales or licensing for B2B use; the pages describe no self-serve sign-up, so the exact registration steps are unverified: behind a sales contact.

reliability_note: A keyless call answered HTTP 401 Supply a valid apikey; over the quota the API answers 429 and content can be delayed.
confidence_note: Key, quota and delivery facts are read from first-party help pages; the price, any trial and the quota sizes are behind a sales contact and unverified.

evidence.proved: the content available depends on the contract
evidence.quote: AP Media API supports the same content as [AP Newsroom](https://newsroom.ap.org/), depending on your contract terms.

evidence.proved: content item pricing follows the contract
evidence.quote: [Content item pricing](https://api.ap.org/media/v/docs/Pricing.htm) based on your contract is returned upon request.

evidence.proved: requests are subject to per-minute and per-day quotas
evidence.quote: API requests are subject to quotas, which limit the number of calls per minute and/or per day.

evidence.proved: search covers 30 days of content plus the archive, depending on the contract
evidence.quote: The AP Media API Search method provides programmatic access to 30 days of content, as well as the full library of current and archive picture, video, audio and graphics content; depending on your contract terms.

evidence.proved: the feed reaches back up to 72 hours
evidence.quote: The AP Media API Feed method and the AP Media Agent allow downloading content up to the last 72 hours; depending on your contract terms.

evidence.proved: the API is designed for B2B integration with content ingestion systems
evidence.quote: No, AP Media API is designed for B2B (Business-to-Business) integration with your content ingestion systems or CMSs.

evidence.proved: an API key is required for every call
evidence.quote: An API key is required for making AP Media API calls.

evidence.proved: going over the quota answers HTTP 429
evidence.quote: If you exceed your quota limit, you will receive a [429 error code](https://api.ap.org/media/v/docs/API_Codes.htm#429_Status_Code).

evidence.proved: a content item can be included in the plan or priced at an extra charge
evidence.quote: | Not Included in Your Plan (Extra Charge) | 851 | All plans | Not included in your plan. Available for an extra charge. |

evidence.proved: a keyless call answers HTTP 401 Supply a valid apikey
a sandbox mode exists for trying the API before a contract is signed
evidence.quote: Sandbox mode allows you to try out the API before you sign a contract with the AP.
No billing. Downloads in the sandbox mode do not incur any charges.

evidence.proved: sandbox gives no main renditions, only demo content
evidence.quote: Restricted downloads. The main renditions of a content item (for example, high-resolution images) are not available for download in the sandbox mode.

evidence.proved: one API key opens every mode the account is permitted
evidence.quote: You can use the same API key to access all of the modes that you are allowed to use.

notes: Storage: no general storage or caching figure is on the pages read; each item carries its own usage restrictions in its metadata. Bulk path: the feed and the AP Media Agent deliver a continuous stream of the last 72 hours, and search reaches 30 days, both within the contract. Free option: none found.
